title: Block 5: Implement the `MasterSynthesizer` phase in `orchestrator.ts`
description: Implement the `MasterSynthesizer` phase in `orchestrator.ts` to traverse the completed `FractalNode` tree and ruthlessly prune competing elements. [Acceptance Criteria: The Synthesizer algorithm demonstrably demotes stylistic properties of competing elements to enforce exactly ONE Concept Anchor, strips total tree animations down to a maximum of 2, and unifies all shadow angles.]
